## EVE-F-Preview 1.0.0

First public release of **EVE-F-Preview**, a community fork of [Proopai/eve-o-preview](https://github.com/Proopai/eve-o-preview).

### Highlights

- Rebranded executable, mutex, logs, and config (`EVE-F-Preview.json`, with legacy `EVE-O-Preview.json` import)
- Character portrait thumbnails when live previews are disabled (ESI cache)
- Account-based thumbnail positioning
- Overwatch mode, dynamic cycle groups, Shortcuts UI
- Settings Sync between characters (with identity scrubbing)
- Config profiles (Load / Save As / Import from EVE-O / EVE-X)
- Toggle-thumbnails hotkey and click-through modifier
- Optional system name overlay from Local chat logs
- Start minimized (separate from minimize-to-tray)

### Requirements

- Windows 10/11
- [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0) (x64)
- EVE clients in Fixed Window or Window Mode (Fullscreen not supported)

### Install

Extract the zip somewhere writable (not Program Files), run `EVE-F-Preview.exe`.
